observations: Photo 0 shows a large, black and grey industrial printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
The front of the printer features a large label with images of printed documents and a 'hp' logo.
The printer is sitting on a wooden stand in an outdoor or warehouse-like environment.
A watermark 'AC VANG TECHNICS' is visible across the center of the image.
The actual printer is not visible in the photo; only the packaging is shown.

claims.claim: HP Color LaserJet Enterprise CP4525 Printer series
claims.evidence: The label in photo 0 shows 'hp' and 'enterprise' but does not clearly show the model number.

claims.claim: Print speed black Normal: Up to 42 ppm
claims.evidence: No photo shows this text; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The photo only shows the packaging; the actual printer may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual printer outside of the wrapping.

risks.risk: The printer may be a generic or lower-spec model despite the 'Enterprise' branding on the label.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).

risks.risk: The printer may have internal mechanical or electrical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, starting a print job, and completing a print.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer outside of the plastic wrapping.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (model number) on the printer.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
